evals.name: fast-fashion-checkout
evals.prompt: Audit the checkout flow of a fast-fashion e-commerce app. It has: pre-checked 'add shipping insurance' ($4.99), a countdown timer ('only 2 left!'), newsletter opt-out buried in settings, and a 'recommended' upsell carousel that delays the checkout button by 3 seconds. Identify dark patterns and give fair alternatives.
evals.expected_output: Pattern-by-pattern identification of dark patterns with named categories, severity assessment, and specific fair pattern replacements with implementation guidance.

evals.name: subscription-management
evals.prompt: Our SaaS product makes it easy to upgrade (one click) but requires users to: find the cancel option (buried in Account > Billing > Plan Details > Advanced), confirm cancellation twice, sit through a 'we'll miss you' retention flow, wait 3 business days for 'processing,' and then confirm again via email. Apply Fair Patterns.
evals.expected_output: Audit naming each dark pattern, the asymmetry between upgrade/downgrade friction, and fair pattern alternatives that respect user autonomy.

evals.name: cookie-consent-redesign
evals.prompt: Our cookie consent banner has a big green 'Accept All' button and a small grey 'Manage preferences' link that opens a 4-step wizard. Run a Fair Patterns analysis and redesign it.
evals.expected_output: Analysis of the consent dark pattern with fair alternative designs that give equal visual weight to accept/reject, minimize clicks for privacy-protective choices.
